title: Compatible augmented cosimplicial Godement maps across schemes
statement: Let X,X′ be schemes [def-pc-scheme] and f:X′→X. Let F,G be module sheaves on X and F₁,G₁ on X′ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], with additive monoidal tensor structures [lem-pc-sheaf-modules-tensor-closed]. Let φ:F→f_*F₁, ψ:G→f_*G₁ and χ:F⊗G→f_*(F₁⊗G₁), with χ(x⊗y)=φ(x)⊗ψ(y) on every inverse-image open. For augmented concrete Godement models A,B,C and A₁,B₁,C₁ [def-sc-module-cup-godement-model] of these six coefficient sheaves, with their prescribed codegeneracies [def-sc-module-cup-godement-codegeneracies], there exist cosimplicial pairings μ:A⊗B→C, μ₁:A₁⊗B₁→C₁ and natural transformations g:A→A₁⋙f_*, h:B→B₁⋙f_*, k:C→C₁⋙f_*. The pairings induce the two degree-zero augmentation morphism equations (a⁰⊗b⁰);ZeroPair(μ)=c⁰ and its counterpart on X′. The natural transformations commute with φ,ψ,χ and their augmentations after the degree-zero extension identifications [lem-sc-module-cup-godement-cosimplicial-input]. In every simplex degree and on every open V, k(μ(x⊗y))=μ₁(g(x)⊗h(y)) on f⁻¹V. No comparison of extended chain complexes or Alexander–Whitney summands is asserted.

proof.text: For H → f_*H′, define the semilinear stalk map at x′ by representing a germ at f(x′) on V, applying the coefficient map on f⁻¹V and taking its germ at x′. Common refinements show independence of representative. Define the product-of-stalk-skyscrapers map coordinatewise: its x′ component is the stalk image of the f(x′) component. Scalar compatibility follows from the structure-sheaf morphism; restriction forgets the same coordinates. This gives an actual morphism T_X H → f_*T_X′ H′.

Projecting to x′ proves compatibility with the germ unit, since both maps take the germ of the coefficient image. For multiplication represent an outer germ on V, then evaluate its coordinate; in either order this is the coefficient stalk image of the inner coordinate. Recursively apply the coordinate construction to φ, ψ, χ. Induction on insertion or collapse position proves compatibility with every coface and codegeneracy. Transport by the six model term equalities. The codegeneracy and model witnesses of these equalities agree by proof irrelevance; generating cofaces and codegeneracies then give natural transformations g,h,k. The unit identity and the augmentation clauses give the three degree-zero squares.

Use the explicit coordinate tensor maps of new-module-cup-godement-tensor-coordinates-exists on both schemes. Starting from p₀=id, set pₙ₊₁=β(TⁿF,TⁿG);T(pₙ). Coordinate unit and multiplication identities imply compatibility with insertions and collapses; transport the maps to obtain μ and μ₁. Their degree-zero augmentation equations follow from the unit identity, exactly as in the pairing-for-models construction. It is essential to use the coordinate maps, rather than independent unspecified pairings.

At n=0 the pairing square is hχ. Represent both germs on a common neighbourhood of f(x′); apply hχ there to obtain compatibility of the one-step coordinate tensor maps with the stalk images. Induct on n, using the coordinate map construction and pₙ₊₁=β;T(pₙ), to obtain the pairing square at every iterate. Transport to degree n of the six cosimplicial models. This proves only the displayed sectionwise pairing square, not extended chain maps or front/back summands. For an empty scheme all coordinate checks are vacuous; zero coefficients give zero families; at degree zero the augmentation is the germ unit.

theorem moduleCup_godement_fmap_models (X X' : Scheme.{v}) (f : X' ⟶ X)
    [MonoidalPreadditive X.Modules] [MonoidalPreadditive X'.Modules]
    (F G : X.Modules) (F₁ G₁ : X'.Modules)
    (φ : F ⟶ (pushforward f).obj F₁) (ψ : G ⟶ (pushforward f).obj G₁)
    (χ : F ⊗ G ⟶ (pushforward f).obj (F₁ ⊗ G₁))
    (hχ : ∀ (V : X.Opens) (x : Γ(F, V)) (y : Γ(G, V)),
      χ.val.app (op V) (tmulSection x y) =
        tmulSection (φ.val.app (op V) x) (ψ.val.app (op V) y))
    (A B C : CosimplicialObject X.Modules)
      (A₁ B₁ C₁ : CosimplicialObject X'.Modules)
      (a : (CochainComplex.singleFunctor X.Modules 0).obj F ⟶
        moduleCup_cosimplicialComplex X A)
      (b : (CochainComplex.singleFunctor X.Modules 0).obj G ⟶
        moduleCup_cosimplicialComplex X B)
      (c : (CochainComplex.singleFunctor X.Modules 0).obj (F ⊗ G) ⟶
        moduleCup_cosimplicialComplex X C)
      (a₁ : (CochainComplex.singleFunctor X'.Modules 0).obj F₁ ⟶
        moduleCup_cosimplicialComplex X' A₁)
      (b₁ : (CochainComplex.singleFunctor X'.Modules 0).obj G₁ ⟶
        moduleCup_cosimplicialComplex X' B₁)
      (c₁ : (CochainComplex.singleFunctor X'.Modules 0).obj
        (F₁ ⊗ G₁) ⟶
        moduleCup_cosimplicialComplex X' C₁)
    (hA : ModuleCupGodementModel X F A a) (hB : ModuleCupGodementModel X G B b)
    (hC : ModuleCupGodementModel X (F ⊗ G) C c)
    (hA₁ : ModuleCupGodementModel X' F₁ A₁ a₁)
    (hB₁ : ModuleCupGodementModel X' G₁ B₁ b₁)
    (hC₁ : ModuleCupGodementModel X'
      (F₁ ⊗ G₁) C₁ c₁)
    (sA : ModuleCupGodementCodegeneracies X F A)
    (sB : ModuleCupGodementCodegeneracies X G B)
    (sC : ModuleCupGodementCodegeneracies X (F ⊗ G) C)
    (sA₁ : ModuleCupGodementCodegeneracies X' F₁ A₁)
    (sB₁ : ModuleCupGodementCodegeneracies X' G₁ B₁)
    (sC₁ : ModuleCupGodementCodegeneracies X'
      (F₁ ⊗ G₁) C₁) :
    ∃ (μ : moduleCup_cosimplicialTensor X A B ⟶ C)
      (μ₁ : moduleCup_cosimplicialTensor X' A₁ B₁ ⟶ C₁)
      (g : A ⟶ A₁ ⋙ pushforward f) (h : B ⟶ B₁ ⋙ pushforward f)
      (k : C ⟶ C₁ ⋙ pushforward f),
      ((a.f 0) ⊗ₘ (b.f 0)) ≫ moduleCup_cosimplicialZeroPair X A B C μ = c.f 0 ∧
      ((a₁.f 0) ⊗ₘ (b₁.f 0)) ≫ moduleCup_cosimplicialZeroPair X' A₁ B₁ C₁ μ₁ =
        c₁.f 0 ∧
      a.f 0 ≫ (moduleCup_cosimplicialZeroIso X A).hom ≫ g.app ⦋0⦌ =
        φ ≫ (pushforward f).map (a₁.f 0 ≫ (moduleCup_cosimplicialZeroIso X' A₁).hom) ∧
      b.f 0 ≫ (moduleCup_cosimplicialZeroIso X B).hom ≫ h.app ⦋0⦌ =
        ψ ≫ (pushforward f).map (b₁.f 0 ≫ (moduleCup_cosimplicialZeroIso X' B₁).hom) ∧
      c.f 0 ≫ (moduleCup_cosimplicialZeroIso X C).hom ≫ k.app ⦋0⦌ =
        χ ≫ (pushforward f).map (c₁.f 0 ≫ (moduleCup_cosimplicialZeroIso X' C₁).hom) ∧
      ∀ (n : SimplexCategory) (V : X.Opens)
        (x : Γ(A.obj n, V)) (y : Γ(B.obj n, V)),
        (k.app n).val.app (op V) ((μ.app n).val.app (op V) (tmulSection x y)) =
          (μ₁.app n).val.app (op (f ⁻¹ᵁ V))
            (tmulSection ((g.app n).val.app (op V) x) ((h.app n).val.app (op V) y))
